For first users I'd skip cold outreach and walk into 10 or 15 independent restaurants within a few miles of you, ideally during the 2-4pm lull, and ask the owner or GM how they reorder right now. Most of them run it off a clipboard or a text thread to the distributor, so you'll learn the exact pain fast. Then pick one kind of place, like taquerias or small breakfast spots, since they tend to have similar inventory, and offer a free 3-week pilot in exchange for feedback and a quick call each week. Before you build much, see if you can sit in on one reorder cycle and map how the numbers flow. Also try r/restaurateur and local restaurant owner Facebook groups, and ask the distributor reps who call on those places, since they know which owners are frustrated with ordering. Happy to tag along on a visit or be a sounding board if you want, though I'm pretty slammed with my own side stuff right now.

    par: float
